The '''Western Watchwoods''' was the name given to the western part of the forest located on the northern edge of the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], at the foot of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] where [[Voss-Ka]] was located. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire's]] [[Outpost Skyline]] was located on the western edge of the Western Watchwoods, while the [[Koss Overlook]] marked the border between the Western and [[Eastern Watchwoods]].<ref name="TOR" />
